content: We have carbon NMR shifts list. Need number of methyl (CH3) groups. Methyl carbons typically appear around 10-30 ppm (alkyl). In list we have low-field: 14.05, 18.60, 22.65, 27.60, 28.70, 31.31. That's six signals in that region. However some could be other carbons like methylene (CH2) also in similar region. Need to determine methyl groups count. Could also use proton NMR to see methyl signals. Let's get proton NMR.
